annotations.title: Score a food from its label

description: Scores a food from its label: the ingredient list and/or the nutrition facts, for example from a photo of the packaging or pasted text, including products that aren't in the database. Most accurate with the ingredient list exactly as printed, including E-numbers and words in brackets. Nutrition values can be per 100 g or per serving (with the serving size). Returns the same 0-100 score and reports any missing data.

category.description: Nutri-Score family. Use fat_oil_nuts_seeds for oils, butter, nuts and nut butters; cheese for cheese; red_meat for beef, pork or lamb products.

fruit_veg_percent.description: % of fruit, vegetables and legumes, if the label states it.

ingredients_text.description: The full ingredient list exactly as printed.

is_drink.description: True for beverages (milk and plant drinks included). Values are then per 100 ml.

nutrition.description: The nutrition facts table, copied exactly.

basis.description: What the numbers refer to. EU labels are usually per 100 g/ml; US Nutrition Facts are per serving.

serving_size.description: Serving size in g (or ml for drinks). Required when basis is per_serving.

sodium_mg.description: Sodium in milligrams (US labels). Use salt_g instead if the label shows salt.

name: analyze_label
title: Score a food from its label
